message:
test(rel-0164): old-APK lane r2 -- arm P's empty sign-in store confirmed before any tap, 1-7 mapped to what each arm's UI really has

Codex codex_rel_0164_old_apk_lane_decision.md. Test-only.
- arm P: the published 0.2.32 starts ONCE (installed + pm clear first); its own log must say auto_login
  NO_CREDENTIAL and no sign_in_store line before 수동 연결 is tapped, else INVALID (b554e76 LoginFlow: an empty
  vault sends nothing). Its start-up update check (derived from the fixed https directory, no credential) is
  recorded. 2: the manual DIRECT connect judged from the host's log (one TCP control client). 5 / 6 NOT RUN: the
  manual UI has no PC 목록 (SessionPark.canPark false); P-5d 연결 해제 -> connect form (host TCP client gone) and
  P-6r connect again -> desktop -> picture are recorded under their own names.
- arm S: the host's lines of the ordinary connect are recorded (the path 0.2.32 really took).
- oa_apk_diff.py: the effective difference of the two APKs from the files (signer, debuggable, ABIs, dex
  constants and strings, native libs).
